questions.text: A shaft with $3\text{ metres}$ span between two bearings carries two masses of $10\text{ kg}$ and $20\text{ kg}$ acting at the extremities of the arms $0.45\text{ m}$ and $0.6\text{ m}$ long respectively. The planes in which these masses rotate are $1.2\text{ m}$ and $2.4\text{ m}$ respectively from the left end bearing supporting the shaft. The angle between the arms is $60^\circ$. The speed of rotation of the shaft is $200\text{ r.p.m.}$ If the masses are balanced by two counter-masses rotating with the shaft acting at radii of $0.3\text{ m}$ and placed at $0.3\text{ m}$ from each bearing centres, estimate the magnitude of the two balance masses and their orientation with respect to the $X$-axis, i.e., mass of $10\text{ kg}$.
